title: Saved world
description: Saved simulation state: header, world, player, map, objects, managers and view. The schema also accepts partial synthetic documents for contract tests.

map_id.description: The map of the world: maps/<id>/ of the pack.

areas_open.description: Open flag of every beach area, then every sea area, in the map's area order.

cell_state.description: The cell words: one run-length list of [count, value] per field, in cell order (saves.md, Map cells).

objects.description: ObjectManager: the id the next new object gets and the global keyline switch.

repair.description: RepairManager: waiting building jobs (type 0 inspection, 2 breakdown), scenery jobs and the jobs mechanics have taken.

feedback.description: FeedbackManager: queued and shown feedback (the object id it is about, negative for world notices, and the shown text), per-staff message counters, suppressed message ids.

messages.description: MessageHandler: delayed messages; type is the engine message type, time the delivery time in game seconds.

cleaning.description: CleaningManager: waiting jobs and the jobs cleaners have taken.

construction.description: ConstructionManager: build and demolition jobs by building object id with hoardings and work points, and the builders.

work_point_owners.description: Builder token holding each work point; -1 means free, and so does a missing entry.

desire_modifiers.description: Added to a guest's desires when a weather entry activates.

weather.description: Weather: light cycle, active weather kind (state 0..5) and its desire modifiers, lightning.

ferry.description: FerryManager: the boat schedule, the index of the next boat (-1 past the end), pending performance boats and departure statistics per guest type slot.

events.description: EventManager: cursor and size of the scenario's disaster schedule, the running events by schedule index.

commodities.description: Missed desires per commodity family since the last half-hourly feedback review. When absent, loading leaves these counters unchanged.

served.description: Beers served by all buildings since the last random effect; every twentieth serving draws an effect.

beer.description: Beer round shared by every bar. When absent, loading preserves the session counter.

camera.description: Top-left corner of the view in map pixels.

position.description: The camera as floats (camera is truncated from it).

class.description: The class of a staff member or performer, which the loader requires for those kinds.

created_as.description: Creation content key when it differs from `type`; for example sample_tree_tall for sample_tree.

dir.description: Rotation of a building (a quarter turn per step: n, e, s, w); other kinds keep their facing in their own state.

object_ref.description: An object id of `objects`, or -1 for none.

boat.description: One ferry arrival: guest_info 0 random count, 1 fixed, 2 per guest type entry, 3 performance; guests_by_type names scenario guest types (unused tail left out).

sprite_state.description: Sprite animation state; `dir` is the facing (left out for buildings, whose rotation is the object's `dir`).

base_state.description: Entity state; `sprite` is the sprite name under the content key rule.

moving_state.description: Mover state (guests, staff, vehicles, sharks, performers); `path` while walking a path. `building` is an object id or -1 (none).

building_traversal.description: Direction flag: zero means forwards, nonzero means backwards. The byte value is preserved.

scenery_state.description: SceneryObject state; `owner_building` is an object id or -1 (none).

staff_state.description: StaffObject state shared by every profession; `home` and `goto_object` are object ids.

target_happiness.description: Happiness transition (target, rate per update, active). When the three fields are absent, constructor values are preserved.

service_state.description: Service staff action state, including restaurant waiters; shared staff fields are stored separately.

lifeguard_state.description: Lifeguard rescue, movement, feedback and activity state.

mechanic_state.description: Mechanic repair, inspection, watering and activity state.

rep_state.description: Guest representative conversation, feedback and activity state.

builder_state.description: Builder job, work location, feedback and activity state.

cleaner_state.description: Cleaner job, cleaning totals, feedback and activity state.

security_state.description: Security patrol, offences, fines, feedback and activity state.

shark_state.description: Shark state; `victim` and `owner` (set by the script) are object ids.

attached_sprite.description: A sprite attached by the script: the sprite name (content key) and its state.

vehicle_state.description: Vehicle state; `guests` and `owner` are object ids, `vehicle_type` the vehicle enum.

table_state.description: Furniture state: chairs (with sprites when the table has chair sprites), the waiter, plates.

guest_state.description: GuestObject state; ids are numbers, the *_type fields catalog buildings (null none).

topless.description: Whether the guest is topless. When this, times_blocked, mood_icon_time or worst is absent, its constructor value is preserved.

worst.description: The worst spot of the day (object id), the counterpart of `best`.

catalog_ref.description: A catalog content key, or null for none.

building_state.description: BuildingObject state; ids are numbers, `beer` and event slots catalog keys (null none).

tail.description: Position where the next guest stands. When absent, loading preserves the reconstructed tail.

points.description: The limit + 1 standing points of a queue with limit 1..10, serve side first. When absent, loading reconstructs a straight line from the serve point.

performer_state.description: Performer state; `owner` (the show building) and `contestant` are object ids.

object_state.description: A state name of the pack's scripts/object_vocabulary.json, or the number of a state the pack does not name.

desire_values.description: One float per guest desire; a missing desire is 0.
